Author: Yunus Alperen
Name: Regions of XIV
Punchline: A beautiful area notification as you walk in and out of zones.
Description:
Announces the region, zone, area and sub-area you walk into with a styled, animated on-screen notification.

Final Fantasy XIV changes your sub-area silently, with no on-screen feedback beyond the small text above the minimap. Regions of XIV surfaces those transitions, and lets you restyle zone announcements to taste.

Inspired by Nekres' "Regions of Tyria" for Guild Wars 2.

Open settings with /regions.
